description: Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Council and Local Government - Public and Bank Holidays for the year 2024
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice declaring public and bank holidays for 2024 under the authority of the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971. While it mentions the Prime Minister/Minister's name and title, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than announcing a personnel change or detailing portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
